body.statement: When \(W=\varnothing\) and \(\Pi\) entails strict positivity of every observed cell over \(\prod_{i\in V}\Omega_i\), the classical reduction is a deferred derived consequence of an affirmative resolution of \(\mathrm{oeq:latent-lifting}\), not a standalone consequence of the present construction handles. Once that resolution supplies concrete productions and a compiler satisfying the classical-ID embedding invariant, induction on the bisimilar ordinary \(\operatorname{ID}\) call tree proves that the restricted \(\operatorname{FID\text{-}S}(G,\Omega,W,\Pi,x,y)\) trace uses the same ordered cases and side conditions, and that its successful compiled expression equals the ordinary ID functional up to explicit algebraic normalization, with every guard discharged by strict positivity. If the trace terminates in case \((5)\), its payload contains the actual failed recursive call, \(\operatorname{FAIL}(\mathcal G_c,\mathcal G_c[S])\), and its original-query provenance; the payload certifies a hedge for that failed query or subquery, Shpitser--Pearl Theorem 17 certifies nonidentification there, and the conclusion for the original query is only that there exist \(Y'\subseteq Y\) and \(X'\subseteq X\) such that \(P(Y'\mid\operatorname{do}(X'))\) has the relevant hedge.
body.justification: This is a deferred sanity corollary of the classical-ID embedding invariant, to be proved by induction on the bisimilar ID call tree after the open construction supplies concrete productions and a compiler.
body.gap: The present construction handles do not define grammar transitions, compilation, or failure payloads. Consequently the proposition cannot yet be proved without assuming the missing open construction, and its hedge conclusion must remain scoped to the actual failed subquery with only the corrected existential-subquery conclusion for the original query.
body.consumer: Once the latent-lifting question is affirmatively resolved, ordinary-ID users obtain the same recursive trace and normalized formula on successful inputs and an auditable, correctly scoped failure certificate otherwise.

obligation.what_is_open: Instantiate the deferred induction by supplying the concrete restricted grammar productions, compiler, state embedding, and provenance updates required by the narrowed latent-lifting specification.
obligation.obstruction: Strict positivity and \(W=\varnothing\) eliminate the support-specific and functional branches, but they do not supply a transition relation or compiler from the present construction handles. Until the open latent-lifting question supplies those data, there is no grammar call tree, no compiler output, and no case \((5)\) payload to compare with ordinary ID.
obligation.attempted: I formulated structural induction over the seven ordered ordinary-ID cases and isolated its base and recursive obligations. Each obligation reduces to one direction of the required trace-preserving bisimulation or to compiler preservation, so proceeding further would assume the missing invariant rather than derive it.
obligation.partial_result: Under \(W=\varnothing\) and full observed-cell positivity, a concrete trace-preserving bisimulation with the seven ordered ID cases would prove the conditional reduction by structural induction on the finite ID call tree. Transition matching handles recursive nodes; multiplication and marginalization handle case \((4)\); cases \((1)\) and \((6)\) handle successful leaves; and the recorded case \((5)\) payload handles a failed leaf at the corrected subquery scope. The frozen trace-grammar and procedure construction handles, however, specify neither productions nor a compiler, so the induction relation and its base cases cannot yet be instantiated.
